openPorts.protectedText: SSH (22), WireGuard (51820+) and Admin API ports are protected and cannot be closed. Closing these ports could disconnect you from the server.

vpnRules.intro: Rules that decide which traffic may pass between VPN networks

empty.title: VPN Inter-Network Rules
empty.subtitle: Define how traffic flows between VPN networks
empty.whatBody: VPN rules control the server's FORWARD chain. These rules determine whether traffic can pass between different VPN networks. Since all VPN traffic flows through the server, these rules provide complete control over inter-network communication.
empty.allow1: Access admin panel from office network
empty.allow2: Allow specific devices to reach other networks
empty.howBody: All VPN traffic flows through the server. VPN rules are applied on the server and determine which traffic can be forwarded.
empty.noteBody: Networks cannot see each other by default. A rule takes effect on the server at once; devices need no new configuration (only when a rule names an address range outside the VPN does the device page ask you to download it again).

matrix.title: Network policies
matrix.help: Rows: where traffic comes from. Columns: where it goes.
matrix.helpNft: Networks do not see each other; only what a rule allows gets through. A rule works at once, nothing needs doing on the devices.
matrix.helpIptables: Networks do not see each other; only what a rule allows gets through. A rule works at once, nothing needs doing on the devices.

ruleForm.noGroups: No groups yet — create one on the Groups page.
ruleForm.oneWayHint: {{from}} reaches {{to}}; {{to}} cannot start a connection back, it only answers.

decision.rejectHint: Blocked; the sender is told at once.

block.oneWay: {{from}} cannot reach {{to}} ({{what}}). This rule does not touch the other direction.
